definition: As an admin, make skills available to every member, by org skills settings or by bundling them in a plugin.
outcome: the skills appear for every member of the organization in this product without each member adding them

records.outcome: the skills reach every managed member through the plugin that carries them, since the admin portal has no per-skill control
preconditions: the admin portal has no skills view or per-skill controls
steps: Bundle the skills in a plugin, as small as the skill plus a plugin manifest
Add the plugin on the Plugins card
Set the plugin to Auto-install so its skills reach every member
To change or retire the skill later, update or remove the plugin

evidence.quote: bundle them in a plugin, which can be as small as the skill plus a plugin manifest, and add it on the **Plugins** card
